links.outcome: Within-model consistency of LLM feature annotations compared with human annotator agreement
links.effect: LLMs showed high within-model consistency versus moderate human agreement; no numeric consistency value is given in the abstract.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrate high within-model consistency versus moderate human agreement, with distinct assessment strategies: LLMs focus on language/behavioral markers, crowdworkers prioritize social-emotional engagement, clinicians balance both.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark comparing multimodal LLM performance directly against human/crowdworker annotations for extracting behavioral features from home videos to detect autism.
